question.text: If the plane <math><mi>a</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mi>z</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>d</mi></math> contains the line <math><mfrac><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>a</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>d</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>z</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>c</mi></mrow></mfrac></math>, then the value of <math><mfrac><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn><mi>d</mi></mrow></mfrac></math> is equal to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>b</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>d</mi><mo>≠</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mfenced></math>

solution.text:
Since the line lies on the given plane, therefore the point a,2d,c on the line also lies on the plane

⇒a2-2bd+c2=0

Also, the line will be perpendicular to the normal vector of the plane

⇒a2-b2+c2=0

Hence, b2=2bd⇒bd=2⇒b4d=12
